verdict.rationale: Orrick's Technology Companies Group page cites concrete deal volume ($157B across ~3,000 venture financings, Top 5 globally for VC financings) and other location pages describe seed-through-late-stage coverage (Germany: Seed/Series A through Series C+; France/UK: seed to growth capital, No.1 by deal volume in Europe), supporting the core story. However, these stats are largely firm-wide or regional aggregates rather than a single dedicated 'venture financing practice' page with representative transaction examples broken out by round stage. missing for 10: a dedicated venture-financing practice page with named representative deals/transactions by stage, and independent corroboration of volume figures beyond self-reported PitchBook rankings.
